symptoms: Dark brown concentric ring lesions on older/lower leaves
Lesions surrounded by yellow halo
Premature leaf drop
Stem lesions with dark brown sunken areas
management: Remove and destroy severely affected leaves immediately
Avoid overhead irrigation; use drip irrigation
Improve air circulation by proper spacing
Maintain field sanitation — remove crop debris
Consult local agricultural expert for approved fungicide options

symptoms: Water-soaked pale green lesions on leaves
White cottony growth on undersides of leaves
Brown lesions on stems
Rapid fruit rot
management: Remove and destroy infected plant parts
Avoid working in fields when wet
Consult local Krishi Kendra for approved protective measures
prevention: Apply preventive protective measures before disease onset in high-risk weather

symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions on leaf margins
White fungal growth on leaf undersides
Brown rot on tubers
management: Store tubers in cool, dry, ventilated conditions
Consult local agricultural expert for protective management

symptoms: Yellow to white lesions along leaf margins
Lesions with wavy margins
Wilting of seedlings (kresek phase)
Milky or opaque exudate from cut ends of affected leaves

Consult local agricultural extension office for management options
